story_text.value: I wanted to start working on the SEO of my app. The other tools on the market were very expensive. As a hacker I had an itch to make my own lightweight tool that can integrate Google Search Console data or get website data from crawling a url using Google's Gemini. After the report is made the user can chat with a chatbot that is contextually grounded with the report. I found the answers given from the chatbot more helpful from the answers from a general purpose LLM. Context makes a big difference.

story_text.value:
I built a Chrome extension that uses the free Gemini API to read tweets on your X home feed, generate contextual replies, and post them automatically.

It controls the cursor & keyboard, analyzes each post, writes a reply, and repeats for 15 items. Everything is configurable through a system prompt.

Demo video included. Would appreciate feedback on architecture, limitations, and scaling ideas.

story_text.value:
In December 2023, Google introduced its new AI model and API, "Gemini". This article offers a comprehensive guide on accessing API through a simple JavaScript program using the AIsBreaker client library.

AIsBreaker, a developer-friendly platform, simplifies access to a variety of generative AI services including OpenAI/ChatGPT, Google Gemini AI, and more. It effectively conceals the complexity of vendor-specific APIs, in this case, allowing seamless access to Google Gemini AI API via the Google Cloud Vertex AI environment.

title.value: Show HN: Try New Google Gemini AI API – With Aisbreaker.org
